correctness.rationale: At every homogeneous equilibrium the Jacobian factors into modal quadratics. For any real row-stochastic eigenvalue the Jury inequalities are strictly satisfied for 0<delta<1. On r=1/2 and the directed three-cycle, the exact complex Schur–Cohn deficit is -P(delta)/16; P has exactly one positive root in (0,1), with rational bracketing. On either side this yields the claimed stability/instability, with the boundary multipliers characterized. An independent 6-by-6 determinant factorization and all relevant symbolic identities are reproduced by the enclosed exact-arithmetic script; the numerical check at delta=5/6 is illustrative only.

value.rationale: At parameters below the isolated model’s oscillatory boundary, three directed averaging sites already yield nonhomogeneous linear instability while symmetric averaging on any number of sites and arbitrary stochastic averaging on at most two sites cannot. An exact quartic threshold, explicit rational witness, and minimality identify a structural and experimentally discriminating property of the coupled ideal-storage model; this is not a routine numerical instability observation.
